notes.title: V1.5 | Official Release, News & Adjustments!
notes.notes:
Welcome to you potential future players of AnotherQuizzGame!

We are very happy to finally announce the official release of our project AnotherQuizzGame

We have been working on it since 2018 already!
This project will have taught us a lot and even if this game is not AAA or even the game of the decade, we don't care, we love it anyway and we loved it (sometimes not at all) worked on it !

Thank you very much to all those who follow the adventure of AQG since its beginnings
Many thanks to our many beta testers

Thanks to you g@merz for looking at our game.

To thank you, here is 15% off for the outing! ❤



Share your experiences with AnotherQuizzGame via our Discord!

Follow VorTeXDev news on our site web, Instagram and [url =https://twitter.com/VrTXDev_]Twitter

Take the time to put a Positive Vote! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: [UPDATE] Version 1.4 is here !
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40100324/57c261d5ecf52faff6974c67aafa5de70c590ff5.png

Version 1.4 is here !

and here's what she brings with her!

New arrivals :

• Multiplayer !
Face up to 8 Players and respond as fast and as best as possible in order to win the game!

• Player Profile !
Look other player's statistics or, your's


Patchs :

• Cannot click the same button twice in a row at an interval of less than 2 seconds

• Saving sound settings between each game start


Changes :

• Deletion of VorTeXDev accounts ! (We now use Steam Accounts)

• Deletion of confirmation when deleting a quiz


Note : Quizzes and VorTeX accounts have been deleted.



Thanks for reading !
